# Neon Noodle Bar Sign

[Photo](../README.md) › [Layer Styles](../README.md#layer-styles) · `layer-styles` `glow` `type` `shapes`

A glowing neon sign on a brick wall, built from type and stroked shapes with outer and inner glow styles.

![Neon Noodle Bar Sign](thumb.png)

| | |
|---|---|
| Document | [neon-noodle-bar-sign.psd](neon-noodle-bar-sign.psd) (1.8 MB) |
| Contents | 1400 × 900 px; 8 layers; 2 type layers; 3 shape layers; 2 fill layers; 5 styled layers; 2 masks |
| Features | `photo.layer.styles`, `photo.layer.style-basics`, `photo.path.shapes`, `photo.type.point-text` |
| Built by | `kition-photo` @ `7abaa42e9a`: 18 commands in 147 ms |

## About

Each tube is a live layer with two effects: an Outer Glow in the tube's colour for the light
spill and an Inner Glow from the edges for the hot core. The lettering is type, the bowl and the
frame are stroked shapes with no fill, so the glow follows the strokes. The bricks are one shape
layer of 178 sub-paths with a Bevel & Emboss and an Inner Shadow.

- command: layer.layerStyle.bevelEmboss
  params:
    layer: $bricks.layer

  params:

  params:
    from: "#4a1640"
    to: "#000000"

- command: shape.create
  params:

    rect:

    stroke:

      color: "#d6fbff"

  params:

    spread: 10
- command: layer.layerStyle.innerGlow
  params:

    opacity: 90
    size: 3
    source: edge
- command: shape.create
  params:

    stroke:
      width: 8

    name: Bowl Tube
    path:

              - 270

              - 270
        - closed: false

            - - 650
              - 250

              - 200
        - closed: false

            - - 680
              - 255
            - - 760
              - 205
  as: bowl

  params:

    spread: 10
- command: layer.layerStyle.innerGlow
  params:
